r7_six_file_court.fixtures: the commissioned sparse manifest already names the only repository-committed fixture the six-file court reads (WORKER_RETURNS/FIABC-LM2-R1I-PHYSICAL-NATIVE-BINDING/01_PHYSICAL_KEY_INVENTORY.json); no symlink and no widening were needed

pre_hardening_control.purpose: prove the four defects were real and that this review's proofs are discriminating rather than vacuous
pre_hardening_control.method: read-only git archive of the rawlsing_next subtree at the pre-hardening commit, imported instead of the review target; no clone and no worktree

metadata_only_non_route_with_outer_max0.message: ROUTE_PASS_LIMIT_REACHED: full_route_passes maximum of 0 already reached (0 completed); no second source operation was performed

A_route_pass_applicability.defect: route-pass applicability is inferred from the operation rather than bound by the caller; an outer MAX 0 therefore means 'no source operation' and blocks admitted metadata work

B_retry_zero_second_attempt.defect: with SourceAccessBudget.retries = 0, a second attempt after a failed first attempt still reaches real source work (metadata_reads 1 -> 2); the retry ceiling is never consulted and there is no attempts/retries/completions separation at all

lower_layer_postcondition_failure.second_message: ROUTE_PASS_LIMIT_REACHED: full_route_passes maximum of 1 already reached (1 completed); no second source operation was performed

C_completion_before_postconditions.defect: the completed counter is incremented before the lower-layer constraints and before the outer EXACT rule, so a failed attempt still leaves a counted pass behind. With an unbounded-within-maximum outer EXACT, the phantom completion is even admitted into the outer account: attempt 2 reports observed 2 although only one attempt satisfied everything

D_discarded_dependency_injection.defect: BoundSourceExecution accepts pyreadstat_module and then passes None to the session, so a supplied dependency is silently discarded

OBS-1.severity: ADVISORY — unreachable from the seven-source warrant, which always binds SRC27 expected 1 together with maximum 1; and NOT_APPLICABLE + EXACT 1 is still refused at bind. Only a hand-written mis-binding reaches it, and it still refuses without counting a pass.

OBS-1B.severity: ADVISORY — bound maximum is UNBOUND here; the warrant binds expected 1 with maximum 1, where the MAXIMUM gate refuses pre-operation (proved in W2).

OBS-2.severity: ADVISORY — a typo'd MAXIMUM or EXACT-0 constraint is vacuously satisfied because a missing account reads as observed 0. FLOOR and non-zero EXACT fail closed. No warrant-derived constraint depends on an unknown account, so the seven-source binding is unaffected.

OBS-3.severity: OUT OF GRAIN — the commission directs the review to drive the public execute() path, and an in-process owner cannot sandbox a caller that reaches _completed or the broker directly. Recorded only to bound the claim: the binding is a governed entry point, not an isolated interpreter.
